_comment: Master item list — everything Carl can pick up or be handed. Carl's actual inventory lives in the save slot, not here. 'type': consumable = gone after one Use; permanent = reusable, may toggle; container = opened later. 'value' is the item's base gold worth: Bautista's Shop sells it for roughly value x1.3 and buys it back for around value, both haggled by LUCK on the transaction. 'vendor' pins an item to one shop — 'spell-master' = Tiatha only, 'shop' = Bautista only; no 'vendor' lets it show anywhere it fits. 'shopBuyable': false keeps it out of the Shop's BUY list (still sellable). The Loot Box is sell-only by special case (drop-only container). 'learnsAbility' marks a consumable that, read once, permanently unlocks a PERMANENT_ABILITIES entry (js/main.js) on Carl's action bar instead of firing an effect itself — the Spell Master won't sell a second copy once it's known.

items.name: Loot Box
items.description: The System's idea of a participation trophy: a dented, faintly humming cube of alien polymer that drops out of anything worth killing. It refuses to open on command — only when the odds are dramatic and the sponsors are watching. Whatever's inside is scaled to the floor you crack it on: bandages and bent knives down here, worse things later. The System takes its cut of the good stuff first, obviously.
items.tooltip: Loot Box — Use (U) to open it: always some gold (LUCK helps), and a chance at one random item. Consumed on opening.

items.name: Torch
items.description: A fistful of oil-soaked rag on a stick — the crawler's oldest friend. Light it and the dark gives up a little ground: two tiles of sight instead of one. Snuff it to save it. It doesn't burn down, because the System decided realistic torch physics were bad television.
items.tooltipOff: Torch — UNLIT. No effect; sight radius is 1 tile. Use (U) to light it (radius becomes 2). Reusable.
items.tooltipOn: Torch — LIT. Sight radius is 2 tiles. Use (U) to snuff it out (back to 1).

items.name: Small Health Potion
items.description: A thumb-sized vial of something red and faintly carbonated. Tastes like pennies and cough syrup; closes wounds like they were a clerical error. Restores a quarter of Carl's max HP. The System would like to remind you that the Large size is available for purchase.
items.tooltip: Small Health Potion — Use (U) to restore 25% of Max HP. Consumed on use — one and done.

items.name: Dynamite
items.description: A fat red stick of something the System insists is 'legally distinct from dynamite,' with a fuse that burns exactly as long as the drama requires. Lob it in a fight for a flat 2d10 — up to 20 — that armour does nothing about. The crawlspace goblins hoard the stuff; nobody's sure where they get it, and nobody's asking.
items.tooltip: Dynamite — Use (U) in a fight to blast the mob for 2d10 (up to 20), ignoring armour. Costs your turn; the mob still swings back. One and done.

items.name: Fireball Spell
items.description: One combustion spell scrawled on a scrap of butcher paper by somebody who plainly enjoyed the work — the runes still smell of ozone and cheap ink. Read it aloud in a fight: it costs 25 SP to channel, then dumps 3d8+2 of raw fire onto the mob with no aiming roll. Armour still soaks a little, because physics gets a vote even when magic doesn't. The paper burns to ash whether the words catch or not, so check your SP before you commit.
items.tooltip: Fireball Spell — Use (U) in a fight: spend 25 SP to auto-hit the mob for 3d8+2 fire (5–26), minus its armour. Under 25 SP it fizzles — scroll and turn both wasted. Costs your turn; the mob still swings back. One and done.

items.name: Fireball Scroll
items.description: Bound in scorched leather and sealed with a wax sigil that's still faintly warm, this is no one-shot cantrip — it's the whole incantation, memorized rather than merely read. Study it in a quiet moment, well clear of anything with teeth, and the shape of the spell burns itself into Carl's memory for good: Fireball joins his action bar, castable in any fight from then on for the same 25 SP it always cost — no scroll to burn through, no running out.
items.tooltip: Fireball Scroll — Use (U) outside a fight to permanently learn Fireball: it joins your action bar for 25 SP a cast, unlimited casts, ever after. One-time read; the scroll is consumed learning it. Tiatha won't sell a second one once Carl knows it.

items.name: Toenail Armor
items.basedOn: tone: riffs on the series' running gross-out comedy about Carl's post-apocalypse hygiene collapse; not a specific book event
items.description: Weeks without a trim, three System mutations, and one deeply cursed growth spurt later, Carl's toenails stopped being a hygiene problem and became a structural material. Pried off, filed to an edge, and lashed together with boot-leather cord, the plates turn aside a blade about as well as anything else on this floor — and the smell does some of the deterring on its own. Princess Donut has refused to be within ten feet of it since the unveiling.
items.tooltipOff: Toenail Armor — UNEQUIPPED. No effect. Use (U) to strap it on: +7 Defense against every hit. Reusable, no downside — try not to think about it too hard.
items.tooltipOn: Toenail Armor — EQUIPPED. +7 Defense against every hit. Use (U) to take it off.
